title: Enzyme Inhibition
description: A molecule that sits in the enzyme's pocket without reacting slows it down; more substrate can push it out. How most drugs work. Unlocks a cheaper Stem Cell Culture.

puzzle.goal: An inhibitor at level I, with constant Q, sits in the enzyme's pocket and makes it seem to need more substrate. Write the apparent constant A, from the enzyme's own K.
puzzle.name: Raised constant
puzzle.ask: Find A for K = @{K}, I = 3 and J = 1.
puzzle.method: The inhibitor ties up the free enzyme in proportion to I/J, so substrate must be 1 + I/J times higher for the same speed.
